name: Okishima
text: Okishima (沖島, Okishima) or Okinoshima (沖ノ島, Okinoshima) is an island in Shiga Prefecture, Japan. It is part of Biwako Quasi National Park. It is the largest island of Lake Biwa and is administered by the city of Ōmihachiman.

depictions.text: Okishima was a small island on Lake Biwa in Ōmi, Japan.
